THISZONINGLOTDEVELOPMENTAGREEMENT("Agreement")madeasof the23rd day of April, 2014 by and between 130 Flower Corp.("Lot 57 Owner"), having an address of 130 W. 28" Street, New York, N.Y. 10001, and 28"h STREET PROPERTIES LLC, a New York limited liability company ("Developer"), having an address of 15 Pulaski Street, Bayonne, N.J: 07002. WHEREAS, Developer is the owner of certain land, with the buildings and improvements thereon, in the City of New York, Borough of Manhattan, generally known by the street address 132/134 W. 28"h Street, New York, N.Y. 10001 designated as Lot58inBlock803which ismoreparticularlydescribedon Exhibit A annexed hereto and made a part hereof (said land being herein called the "Developer Land," said thereof permitted pursuant to the provisions of this Agreement, being herein called the collectively called the"Developer Premises"); WHEREAS,Lot 57 Owner is the owner of certain land,with the buildings and improvements thereon,in the City of New York, Borough of Manhattan, generally known by street address 130 West 28" Street, New York, N.Y. 10001, designated as Lot 57in Block 803 on the Tax Map of the City of New York and more particularly described on Exhibit B annexed hereto and made a part hereof (said land being herein collectively called the"Lot 57 Land,"said buildings and improvements now erected thereon, together with any future replacement thereof permitted pursuant to the provisions of this Agreement, being herein called the "Lot 57 Building,"and the Lot 57 Land and the Lot 57 Building being herein collectively called the "Lot 57 Premises"); WHEREAS, Developer desires to construct a new building on a site which will include Developer's Premises (the "New Developer Building") with a bulk in excess of the bulk permitted to be constructed on the Developer Land under the Zoning Resolution of theCityofNewYork,effectiveDecember15,1961 as amendedfrom time to time(the "Zoning Resolution") if the Developer Land was considered as a separate and independent zoning lot; WHEREAS, there are Floor Area Development Rights (as hereinafter defined) (the"Excess Floor Area Development Rights") and are available for transfer pursuant to the ZoningResolution; WHEREAS, by execution of a Declaration of Zoning Lot Restrictions of even date and contemporaneously herewith (the "Declaration"), Lot 57 Owner and Developer have utilized theprocedure availablepursuant toSection12-10of theZoningResolution to combine the Lot 57 Landwith the Developer Land so as to create a new,combined zoning lot (the "Combined Zoning Lot") for the purpose of making available the Excess Floor Area Development Rights (as hereinafter defined) for utilization in connection with the construction of the New Developer Building;
